proposals_not_done.reason: GitHub code search and GitLab blob search are implemented and tested on doc-shaped synthetic fixtures but run only with setting code_search_keyed_sources=true: merge gate P305 cond 10 needs trimmed real fixtures captured with the team's tokens (api.github.com blocked by this sandbox proxy; no GitLab token). GitLab global blob search also needs a Premium/Ultimate namespace (refusal reported SKIPPED 'config').

no dated browser check was possible from this sandbox: every link ships verified=false with the '(may show a challenge)' marker; max_tlp/verified='browser'/vetted placeholders live in x_ fields and module links until the core schema adds them (backlog).

`v3lum add-url` (cond 9) and `v3lum links --all` for dork rows (cond 8) are CLI/core work: the router ships as the pure, tested function dork_generator.route_pasted_url and the overflow rows stay in the module evidence.

core_requests: links.py / v3lum.pivot_pack/1 (contract addition): per-link max_tlp honoured by links.render, the renderers and `v3lum links` (list max_tlp-hidden links there with the warning, P304 cond 10 Kaspersky); accept verified='browser' (or read x_verification='browser' + x_checked_by) and a per-link badge field.

links.py placeholders (contract addition): {url_sha256} (SHA-256 of the canonical URL), {url_path} (canonical URL in a path, dot segments refused), {cve_num} (CVE number without prefix), {hunter_q} (percent-encoded base64 of field="value"); encoders and tests are in v3lum/modules/search_dorks/pivots_unverified.py.

renderers / `v3lum links`: rank pack links with the P304 order (verified incl. browser-verified first, then the top tools VirusTotal, AbuseIPDB, Shodan, OTX, Talos, abuse.ch, Wayback), see pivots_unverified.rank_links; apply the A2/A8 tier gates to pack links (unknown-tier hidden at TLP:AMBER+, trusted only at AMBER+STRICT).
`v3lum doctor --links` (WP25): print pivots_unverified.recheck_report(today) (browser checks older than 90 days, never-checked links; offline, P304 cond 12).
CLI `v3lum add-url <url>` (P306 cond 9): call dork_generator.route_pasted_url and attach the routed entity (kind/entity_type/value/attach_to) to the case.
`v3lum links --all` and the terminal view (P306 cond 8): list the dork rows of dork_generator evidence (raw.rows/overflow) beyond the 20-link report cap and show the 5 curated rows (raw.terminal).
v3lum/data/providers/github.json (core seed): add V3LUM_GITHUB_TOKEN to the 'github' key env aliases (P305 key name).
core quota (P334): a per-minute window for github.code_search (10/min, budget 8); code_search keeps it in ctx.state meanwhile.
core sanitize.find_secrets (P312): allowlist documented example credentials (AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE, wJalrXUtnFEMI/K7MDENG/bPxRfiCYEXAMPLEKEY); code_search filters them locally.
notes: P304: nine topic packs unverified_<topic>.json (36 core links + 7 module links); duplicates of links already served by threat_intel_g07*, core_reference, crypto and file_triage packs were not re-added (VirusTotal file/domain/IP, AbuseIPDB IP, OTX IP/file/CVE, ThreatFox, Hybrid Analysis, Shodan host, Wayback URL calendar, Etherscan/BscScan/Tronscan/Arkham). Module links (VirusTotal URL report via {url_sha256}, archive.today capture lists via {url_path}, Exploit-DB via {cve_num}, hunter.how via {hunter_q}, Kaspersky OpenTIP with x_max_tlp clear + RU badge) are rendered by pivots_unverified with A2 labels and tier gates. P305: Sourcegraph keyless by default; GitHub/GitLab gated by code_search_keyed_sources (cond 10); fragments are scanned in memory with the core P312 scanner and never stored (rule ids + installation-HMAC dedup ids only); raw bodies ttl 0. P306: zero-HTTP dork links over a V3LUM-owned pack (35 rows, 12 site lists), privacy/LinkedIn gates, BR phone variants, CPF lint, Ceos destino() port (two deliberate deviations: full LinkedIn slug, medium as a core social platform). Providers created (hosts null/absent in owners.json): centralops, dotdb, icann, censys, spur, archive_today, tgstat, tellows, cisco_talos, ibm_xforce, kaspersky, filescan, metadefender, joesandbox, cvedetails, vulners, exploitdb, meta, sourcegraph, bing, duckduckgo; extensions: cloudflare (radar.cloudflare.com), spamhaus (check.spamhaus.org), github (source code_search). Ids follow the operator/registrable domain so later batches needing the API hosts (Censys, X-Force, OpenTIP, Filescan, MetaDefender, DuckDuckGo, ICANN CZDS) find the file and extend it. No LIGHT/ACTIVE variant is asked by these proposals.
